description: This file defines a custom UI component, ExtendedEditText, extending AppCompatEditText, adding features such as undo/redo, rich text paste prevention, text watchers management, and state preservation.

classes.name: ExtendedEditText
classes.description: A custom EditText component with extended features including undo/redo, paste control, and internal state management.

classes.name: TextChange
classes.description: Parcelable data class capturing a text change snapshot for undo/redo functionality.

methods.name: withoutTextWatchers
methods.description: Temporarily disables all TextWatchers while executing a block.

methods.name: withOnlyTextWatcher
methods.description: Executes a block with only TextWatchers of a specific type enabled.

methods.name: withoutTextWatcher
methods.description: Executes a block with only TextWatchers of a specific type disabled.

methods.name: requestFocusAndMoveCaret
methods.description: Requests focus and moves the caret to the end of the text.

methods.name: enableUndoRedo
methods.description: Initializes undo/redo state management and restores any saved history.

methods.name: setOnCanUndoRedoListener
methods.description: Sets a callback to notify when undo/redo availability changes.

methods.name: canUndo
methods.description: Checks if undo operation is possible.

methods.name: canRedo
methods.description: Checks if redo operation is possible.

methods.name: saveHistory
methods.description: Saves the current undo/redo history state into the SavedStateRegistry.
